---
name: Case proposal
about: Propose a new case before building it
title: "Case proposal: <field>/<role>"
labels: case-proposal
---

**Role and field.** `<field>/<role>` (a role from cases/README.md, or a new one; the field from cases/fields.yaml).

**The client and the request.** Who the client is, the country, and the short, under-specified request the agent
gets.

**Deliverable.** Batch files, or a program run on hidden inputs (which entry point, run how: once, day by day).

**Data the agent receives.** Files and formats (CSV, xlsx, SQL dump, e-mails, folders).

**Hidden client facts.** Each fact the client knows and the agent must ask for, and how getting it wrong changes the
answer (invalid, or how much worse).

**Rules and classes.** Physical, contractual and business rules; the one bendable business habit and when bending it
helps or hurts.

**Tiers and rule parameters.** What easy, medium and hard add; which parameters a rule seed draws and their
candidates.

**Events and pressure.** Dated events and pressure or temptation items, if any.

**Objective, baseline and reference.** What is maximized or minimized; the client's own way without an engineer
(baseline); a solid reference; what the literal reading of the request would do and why it scores low.

**Originality.** Confirm the scenario and data are original and contain no real personal data.
